smyx-fish-color-brightness-assessment-analysis v1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for AI-based assessment of ornamental fish color brightness and vibrancy from aquarium images.
- Supports white balance calibration using in-frame white/gray/ColorChecker reference, fish body region segmentation, and vibrancy scoring (0-100) based on HSV color space, tailored to species and subtype.
- Generates color vibrancy reports with trends and four-level alert strategy (from positive feedback to urgent veterinary suggestion).
- Enforces mandatory open-id retrieval protocol for historical report queries; all queries must use the cloud API and never local records.
- Strict data quality and user/privacy safeguards: unreliable input (e.g., no white reference, low-confidence segmentation) is rejected with specific feedback. No disease/feed/drug recommendations beyond neutral suggestions. 
- Multi-language description and guidance included (English & Chinese).
